notes.title: 2.0 Patch
notes.notes:
The new 2.0 patch is now live!

CHANGELOG:
* Fixed incorrect chest graphic in final dungeon
* Fixed a few issues on some maps
* Fixed Blaze Ore collection quest
* Fixed misinformation in the controls
* You can now heal in the tent on Rishiri Path

notes.title: Crafting Crash
notes.notes:
Due to a recent change with the crafting system, old save files will crash the game when attempting to craft. It is recommended that you start a new game to fix this issue.

Most of the major equipment obtained through crafting can be obtained via different methods for those that do not wish to start a new game.

Apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: 1.5 Patch
